Name: Day1_StrangerArrives
EventDescription: A hooded stranger arrives at the tavern, asking about ancient ruins nearby. He seems to know more than he lets on.

Name: Day2_FactionNegotiation
EventDescription: Representatives from Human and Orc factions meet at the town square to negotiate a fragile ceasefire after recent border skirmishes.

Name: Day3_BetrayalRevealed
EventDescription: Evidence surfaces that a trusted guard has been feeding information to the enemy. Tensions boil over as accusations fly.

Name: Day5_HarvestCelebration
EventDescription: The town gathers in the square for a rare moment of peace - music, food, and a temporary truce between factions.
